prediction.label: PARKINSON
prediction.description: Parkinsonian pattern - reduced alpha with dominant beta activity.

findings.name: Delta Power
findings.explanation: Delta band (0.5-4 Hz) power - dominant in deep sleep and frontal dysfunction.

findings.name: Theta Power
findings.explanation: Theta band (4-8 Hz) power - elevated in drowsiness and depressive states.

findings.name: Alpha Power
findings.explanation: Alpha band (8-13 Hz) power - posterior dominant rhythm; reduced in neurological disease.

findings.name: Beta Power
findings.explanation: Beta band (13-30 Hz) power - increased with cortical activation and in Parkinsonism.

findings.name: Gamma Power
findings.explanation: Gamma band (30-45 Hz) power - associated with epileptogenic activity.

findings.name: Relative Theta
findings.explanation: Theta share of total in-band power.

findings.name: Relative Alpha
findings.explanation: Alpha share of total in-band power.

findings.name: Theta Beta Ratio
findings.explanation: Asendorfer theta/beta ratio - a screening marker of depressive states.

findings.name: Alpha Asymmetry
findings.explanation: Frontal alpha asymmetry - reduced left-right asymmetry is associated with mood symptoms.

findings.name: Spectral Entropy
findings.explanation: Spectral entropy - higher values indicate less organised, more pathological rhythms.

findings.name: Spike Wave Index
findings.explanation: Fraction of the recording occupied by high-amplitude spike-and-wave discharges.

findings.name: Hjorth Mobility
findings.explanation: Hjorth mobility - variance of the derivative over variance of the signal.

findings.name: Hjorth Complexity
findings.explanation: Hjorth complexity - the fractal dimension of the signal.

findings.name: Signal Variance
findings.explanation: Variance of the EEG signal in the analysis window.

findings.name: Artifact Ratio
findings.explanation: Proportion of the window contaminated by movement or eye-blink artefacts.

findings.name: Signal Quality
findings.explanation: Signal quality index derived from spectral cleanliness and artefact load.
